content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261001/cxQpObbudAjbenp.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg

如果你是赛车游戏的忠实粉丝，可能已经拥有了一套方向盘。但如果你还在使用入门级的齿轮或皮带驱动方向盘，且一直因为直驱设备的高昂价格而犹豫不决，那么请关注这次的新优惠。Best Buy 目前正以 349.99 美元的价格提供 Moza Racing R5 直驱赛车方向盘和踏板套装（ PC 专用 ），在享受 30 美元的即时折扣后还可免运费。虽然这看起来优惠幅度不算巨大，但请记住，Moza 的方向盘本身性价比就很出色，且全年极少有折扣。
Moza Racing R5 PC 直驱赛车方向盘优惠 30 美元

R5 并不是 Moza 最便宜的直驱方向盘，这个荣誉属于 Moza R3，其零售价为 279.99 美元，目前没有折扣。两者之间的主要区别在于最大扭矩：R5 提供 5.5Nm 的扭矩，而 R3 为 3.9Nm。两者的价格都比其他替代方案更低：罗技的 G RS50 售价 600 美元（仅方向盘），Fanatec 的 CSL DD Ready2Race 套装售价 540 美元，Simagic 的 Green Flag 套装售价 600 美元，而 Thrustmaster 的 T598 售价为 466 美元。虽然有些竞品在扭矩上限或主机兼容性方面更具优势，但如果以性价比为王，Moza 很难被击败。
那么，是什么让直驱（Direct Drive）成为了赛车模拟器的黄金标准？直驱方向盘直接连接到电机上，这意味着可以实现零延迟的即时力反馈，且不会因齿轮或皮带驱动的阻力而损失动力输出。扭矩额定值越高，感应范围就越广。与齿轮或皮带驱动的方向盘相比，Moza R5 在沉浸感方面有了巨大飞跃，而 5Nm 被认为是发挥直驱技术最佳性能的基准线。
Moza R5 套装包括方向盘（及基座）和踏板。这款 11 英寸的方向盘采用铝合金轮毂、超细纤维皮革握把、Moza 标志性的 RGB 循迹流光换挡指示灯，以及总共 22 个可编程按钮。基座采用航空级铝制外壳、智能温度控制和 15 位超高分辨率编码器。防滑踏板由高强度钢制成，并使用霍尔效应传感器。
Moza R5 为 PC 平台专用

Moza R5 仅适用于 PC，这意味着主机玩家需要另寻他选。对于 神力科莎：拉力、汽车俱乐部 和 Le Mans Ultimate 等竞技性较强的赛车模拟游戏来说，这是一款非常出色的方向盘。它在 Forza Horizon 6 中也有不错的表现，尽管这款游戏比其他游戏更偏向娱乐性，且在设计之初就考虑了手柄操作的友好性。神力科莎：拉力 EVO 目前已在 Steam 开启抢先体验，预计 2027 年正式发布，它是这款方向盘的最佳应用场景之一。遗憾的是（但并不意外），Star Wars Galactic Racer 和 GTA6 预计都不会支持方向盘（GTA6 本身在短时间内也不会推出 PC 版）。

items.title: MTG 玉米迷宫秘室珍品 Superdrop 发布：吉姆·亨森的《魔幻迷宫》、K-Pop 恶魔猎人及漫威丧尸联动加入 魔法…

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261001/ppoWwEbudzExoum.png!a-3-480x.png
威世智目前每月都会推出新的 MTG 秘室珍品，虽然跨界联动对该系列来说并不新鲜，但这次全新的“超级掉落（superdrop）”首次将吉姆·亨森的《魔幻迷宫》（Labyrinth）和 KPop 恶魔猎人带入了这款卡牌游戏。
威世智刚刚发布了“玉米地迷宫超级掉落（Corn Maze Superdrop）”，显然是为了迎接万圣节，但与之前伊藤润二联名款那种黑暗恐怖风格不同，这次的所有系列都相对轻松愉快。当然，对大多数人来说，最大的吸引力将是 KPop 恶魔猎人和《魔幻迷宫》系列——后者包含三个收藏集——以及漫威丧尸（Marvel Zombies）系列。

《魔幻迷宫》的三个掉落系列是本次超级掉落的亮点。其中“Secret Lair x Jim Henson's Labyrinth Fear Me, Love Me”完全专注于哥布林亲缘卡牌，由哥布林大亨穆克斯（Muxus, Goblin Grandee）领衔，这张哥布林核心牌化身为哥布林之王贾雷斯，配以大卫·鲍伊的精美插画。当然，还有一张化作“绑架托比”的抢夺首子（Claim the Firstborn）。不过出于某种原因，这个掉落中还包含一张三定法球（Trinisphere），它其实并不适合任何已知的哥布林套牌，但至少它拥有鲍伊拿着一堆球体的酷炫原画。

如果没有一些几乎无法阅读的卡牌，那就称不上是秘室珍品超级掉落了，这就是“Secret Lair x Jim Henson's Labyrinth: Through the Labyrinth”的由来。这些卡牌上的艺术设计都非常华丽，尽管我完全可以预见到其中一些在牌桌对面很难辨认。尽管如此，威世智还是决定在这个系列中印制翻搅者（Leveler），你可以将其与比姆镇恶霸（The Beamtown Bullies）或塔萨的先知（Thassa's Oracle）组合使用，让你的牌友们恨不得被扔进迷宫里。
还有一个 KPop 恶魔猎人掉落，其中包含一些具有强大组合技潜力的卡牌。这一套附带了释放真实（Freed From The Real）和底层政权裂隙（Underworld Breach），这两张牌在围绕它们构建的套牌中都臭名昭著。毕竟，裂隙在多种赛制中被禁是有原因的。
威世智仍在尝试将更多漫威内容融入 魔法少女甜心 Magical Girl Sweetheart，这次是专注于丧尸亲缘卡牌的漫威丧尸掉落。但是，尽管拥有由丧尸索尔或丧尸绯红女巫领导的指挥官套牌很酷，但除非你真的非常喜欢漫威丧尸，否则这个掉落中的卡牌其实并不值你所支付的高昂价格。

其他一些掉落也非常酷。See Machine 设计的“Manufactured Grounds”掉落为来自秘罗地的原始神器地循环带来了令人惊叹的艺术设计。从纯粹的财务角度来看，那个掉落可能意义不大，但天哪，它看起来确实很酷。然后是“Peace, Love and Treefolk”掉落，它为林木保护者（Timber Protector）提供了除 Lord of the Rings commander decks 之外的首次重要重印。
我可能会买下所有的《魔幻迷宫》掉落，如果你也想抢购其中一个（或全部），“玉米地迷宫超级掉落”将于太平洋时间 10 月 12 日上午 9 点开始发售。威世智甚至会为任何超过 199 美元的订单赠送一张《魔幻迷宫》风格的伊斯的迷宫（Maze of Ith）。

items.title: “Xbox 不卖”——Asha Sharma 否认有关微软考虑出售其游戏业务的报道

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261001/TzNDhabudzBjuAA.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg
Xbox 首席执行官 Asha Sharma 否认了有关微软考虑出售其游戏业务的传闻。
在接受《纽约时报》采访时，Sharma 宣布：“Xbox 不会出售。”
“我们将不惜一切代价让公司走向成功，我们将寻求合适的合作伙伴、合适的运营模式以及实现这一目标所需的一切，”Sharma 继续说道。
自 Sharma 今年早些时候被任命为 Xbox 首席执行官以来，随之而来的是近几个月的裁员和重组，引发了一个核心问题：微软游戏业务的长期前景如何？微软会卖掉 Xbox 吗？这些削减和重组是在为出售做准备吗？
有关潜在变动的细节最初由 The Information 披露，称微软不排除将 Xbox 品牌转变为全资子公司的可能性。该报道指出，此举可能导致 Xbox 作为与其他合作伙伴的合资企业运营，甚至可能被出售。

Sharma 对 Xbox 的重启计划现已变得更加清晰。已有近 2000 名 Xbox 员工被裁减，本财年还将有更多裁员。多家工作室已退出 Xbox 或面临关闭，多款游戏已被取消。Xbox 现在专注于更少但规模更大的游戏 IP，如 上古卷轴IV：湮灭重制版、Fallout 76 和 我的世界：传奇，而像 Halo 这样的项目已移交给 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 的公司动视（Activision）。在这一切变动中，Xbox 已确认的下一代主机项目 Project Helix 的可行性也引发了质疑。
我的世界：传奇
单人, 线上玩家对战, 在线合作, 跨平台联机游戏, 完全支持控制器, 策略, 动作, 多人, 奇幻, 战术, 阖家, 合作, 玩家战斗, 战斗, 控制器, 角色自定义
继承了MC探索与0创造的乐趣，增加了剧情驱动的部分以及独特的策略性和沉浸感，这是一款出色的、休闲、意在长线运营的策略游戏...

虽然有人认为这次重启和随之而来的裁员是让 Xbox 更容易出售的战略一部分，但分析师们并不认同。一些人表示，考虑到微软以 690 亿美元的天价收购了动视暴雪，加上 Xbox 庞大的工资支出、广泛的工作室布局和硬件业务，可能很少有买家有兴趣直接收购整个业务。分析师建议，更可能的情况是，随着微软继续寻求缩减业务规模，大公司可能会挑选 Xbox 的部分资产。
《纽约时报》推测，最终的拆分可能会创建一个独立的 Xbox，在与微软合作的同时，将其成本从公司的资产负债表中剥离。但 Sharma 对这一选项也表示怀疑，她说：“我们与微软还有很长的路要走，我们将从长计议。”
当 Xbox 自身都承认其业务不健康时，谁会去买它呢？Xbox 在财年结束时的利润率仅为 3%，同比下降。如果不计入动视暴雪（Activision Blizzard King），在过去五年中，微软在 Sharma 所称的内容、平台和硬件“补贴”上投入了超过 200 亿美元，但在此期间的年度收入却下降了近 5 亿美元。

“我们的利润率比同类平台和发行业务低 3 到 10 倍，”Sharma 在 7 月宣布裁员的博客文章中表示。“我们在进入第九世代时装机量较小，成本结构较高。为了增长，我们押注于 Game Pass、多平台和更广泛的内容组合。虽然这些业务创造了显著价值，但它们的增长速度并未达到我们的预期。与此同时，我们的核心业务走弱，而我们增加了更多的团队、投资和时间，希望能有更好的结果。现在，行业正面临其历史上最严重的硬件危机。我们必须重启 Xbox。”
与此同时，微软提高了 Xbox 主机的价格。微软将其归因于主机存储和内存价格上涨了 2.5 倍以上，并预计到 2027 年秋季还会再翻一倍。“整个消费电子行业都在与当前的零部件危机作斗争，但对主机的影响尤为严重，”微软在宣布涨价时表示。Sharma 在 Xbox “重启”备忘录中补充道：“……行业正面临其历史上最严重的硬件危机。”
目前，Sharma 的重点是发展 Xbox。她告诉《纽约时报》，Xbox 每月仍有 5 亿玩家。微软的雄心目标是让 Xbox 每天触达 10 亿人——这一数字在网上遭到了嘲讽。Xbox 将如何实现这一目标？据《纽约时报》报道，通过云计算进入非洲和南亚等市场，并投资 我的世界：传奇 作为 Roblox 的竞争对手。

Capcom 对于 生化危机4：重制版 重制版系列最终追上该系列新作后的情况已有计划，并将 生化危机4：重制版 7 视为一个“转折点”。

这是根据 Capcom 资深人士竹内润（Jun Takeuchi）的说法。他在过去十年中担任该系列的执行制作人，他承认 Capcom 备受欢迎的重制版系列正逐渐面临经典游戏重发资源枯竭的现状。该发行商已经非常成功地重制了 生化危机4：重制版 2、生化危机4：重制版 3 和 生化危机4：重制版 4，而新版 生化危机4：重制版 Veronica（Code Veronica）计划于明年推出。
此前有报道称，生化危机4：重制版 0 的重制版将于 2028 年推出，生化危机4：重制版 1 的重制版也在考虑之中。在 生化危机4：重制版 的正统系列中，届时将只剩下 生化危机4：重制版 5 和 生化危机4：重制版 6 尚未推出新版本——出于各自不同的原因，这两部作品的前景都非常有趣。

虽然 Capcom 可能拥有足够的重制版资源来维持未来十年的发布，但总会有一个时间点，发行商需要决定是重制其他作品，还是重新开始重制那些已经重制过的游戏。或者……做点别的，竹内润如此暗示道。
“目前的 生化危机4：重制版 系列正沿着两条轨道开发，”竹内润在刚刚于日本出版的 生化危机2 重制版 30 周年纪念特刊中写道。
“总有一天，重制系列会追上数字正统续作的时代，我们已经在思考届时该怎么做，”他继续说道。“事实上，从 生化危机4：重制版 Village 前后开始，我们就在逐步为此做准备。像 Umbrella 和 Spencer 等名字的出现，以及 Raccoon City 在 生化危机：安魂曲 中的回归，也都是在为‘交汇’做准备。”
“起初，我们加入这些元素是出于粉丝福利的心态，但用户的反应比我们想象的要热烈得多，他们甚至开始分析开发团队私下保留的想法。因此，作为一个系列，我们决定回应用户的期望，并在 生化危机4：重制版 Village 和 生化危机：安魂曲 中进一步推进这种设定。”
竹内润接着表示，Capcom 将 生化危机4：重制版 7 视为“该系列的转折点”，因为当重制老游戏的计划真正付诸实施时，该作正处于开发阶段。这是否意味着 生化危机4：重制版 7 之前的所有作品都有朝一日会被重制，而 生化危机4：重制版 7 及之后的作品则被认为太新了？

生化危机4：重制版 5 的销量非常出色，尤其是在评价极高的 生化危机4：重制版 4 之后，玩家对该作表现出了浓厚的兴趣。（遗憾的是，生化危机4：重制版 5 的质量远不及前者。）但任何新版本的推出都会让 Capcom 重新面对关于 生化危机4：重制版 5 非洲背景和同伴角色 Sheva 的争议。至于拥有多位主角的 生化危机4：重制版 6，其评价并不理想。但也许 Capcom 可以在未来的新版本中对其进行挽救？
这里更有趣的是，Capcom 暗示它正在利用重制版来播下种子，以便在最终实现“交汇”点时，在新作中重新拾起这些创意。毕竟，生化危机4：重制版 已经走过了 30 年，对于任何人来说，如果不重新游玩早期作品，很难记住这么长时间跨度的剧情细节。
不过目前来看，这一切还有很长一段路要走——还有很多值得期待的内容。前景看好的 生化危机4：重制版 Veronica 是下一个待办事项，我们已经向 Capcom 提出了一些我们非常关心的核心问题……

content.v: 作为这款MOBA的首份正式开发更新，公告明确表示《异锁》的此次大型更新并不代表游戏即将开启公测。这款采用邀请制的游戏仍在持续扩充内容、优化品质，但V社称目前仍有大量工作有待完成。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790815853_353793.jpg
V社在更新公告开篇表示：“我们认为打造一款多人游戏难度极高且充满风险，而降低风险的最佳方式，就是尽早让玩家接触到游戏，帮助我们打磨方向，反馈哪些内容有趣、哪些不尽人意。”
今年早些时候，《异锁》推出“旧神新血”更新，加入六位新英雄与大量视觉重制内容。尽管并非所有游戏内容都得到了调整，但更新覆盖范围之广，一度让外界认为《异锁》将进入下一开发阶段。地图与诸多游戏系统的完成度，就抢先体验游戏的普遍标准而言，已经很难再用“未完成”来形容。
但V社向来按自身节奏推进开发，这一次并没有扩大测试范围的打算。V社在新公告中回顾那次更新时表示：“在进入游戏开发的更深层打磨阶段（比如更新老英雄的美术素材）之前，我们认为核心玩法本身还有不少工作要做。”
V社表示，《异锁》开发团队今年不再局限于深耕特定模块，而是开始并行推进多项工作。其中大部分内容已实装到最新的“不夜城”更新中，比如重制后的地图与装备，但还有部分内容仍在开发路上：“这其中甚至包括成长系统、英雄/据点自定义功能等，我们认为在游戏正式推出前，这些功能需要根据玩家反馈进行调整与大幅修改。”
V社还提到：“我们近期还在推进一些更具探索性的内容——也就是说根据测试效果，我们还不能百分百确定这些内容是否会实装，不过目前的测试结果都很不错——比如大规模的装备重制与新增内容，以及能够拓展游戏边界的其他玩法模式。”据悉，新玩法模式可能包含此前传闻的、由前《雨中冒险》开发者打造的PvE模式。
V社表示，老英雄的视觉更新原本计划在“早期开发阶段末期”启动，但团队“可能会在近期逐步推进这项工作，与其他内容一同加入后续更新中”。
我很好奇是什么促使团队提前启动了这项工作，毕竟听起来《异锁》的“早期开发阶段”似乎还没结束——还是说其实已经告一段落了?V社的这份更新公告并没有明确说明，游戏何时才能达到进入打磨阶段的完成度标准。
就目前来看，唯一的相关信号或许就是大批英雄开始迎来美术更新。但即便到了那个时候，我们也无法确定V社是否会在游戏尽善尽美之前就开启公测。如果你想一睹其诡异地图与奇葩英雄阵容的风采，最好还是找有资格的人索要邀请码，毕竟照目前情况看，V社短期内是不会把这款游戏放出“笼子”的。

content.v: 每到国庆长假，出行就成为绕不开的话题。现实里热门景区人潮涌动，高速堵车、景点排队、门票预约，让不少人的出游计划消耗大量精力。有人奔赴远方看山河，也有人选择留在家中，却苦于找不到自在的消遣方式，倍感无聊。恰逢Steam26年秋促全面开启，海量游戏引来折扣特惠的最佳入手时期，这里想强烈推荐两款非常适配假期娱乐放松的佳作：《极限 竞速 ：地平线6》与《极限竞速：地平线5》。
作为微软旗下 开放世界 赛车大作，《极限竞速：地平线》系列为国庆假期提供了一种全新的松弛打开方式：无需费时费力，在游戏的广阔开放世界中，握紧方向盘，踩下油门，就能赴一场由你自己说了算的地平线赛博旅行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790661252_733619.webp
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790661252_782019.webp

现实中想要打卡东京街景、箱根山道、富士山旷野与北国海岸，往往需要长途奔波，往返于各景点之间。而在《极限竞速：地平线6》中，所有风景全天候开放、无人数限制。你可以驾驶AE86、GT‑R等经典JDM跑车穿梭在霓虹城市街巷；也可以驱车驶入蜿蜒峠道饱览山间层叠风光；或是驶向开阔原野邂逅一场静谧的飞雪。双线并行叙事、持续更新的赛季内容以及线上车聚、淘汰之王等多人模式，让这款游戏兼备单人探险与联机互动的双重体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790661252_763054.webp
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790661252_595428.webp
恰逢游戏S5「英伦汽车嘉年华」赛季火热进行中，全新英伦经典车型、专属漂移挑战模式、主题车商与限定奖励同步上线，让这场虚拟旅途不止有风景，更有持续新鲜的探索乐趣。毕竟，没有人能拒绝开着宾利、阿斯顿・马丁、捷豹等英伦传奇跑车，在漂移计分赛的全新赛道上来一次炫酷飞驰的“出片”体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790661252_507380.webp

而《极限竞速：地平线5》则送给玩家一场热烈奔放的墨西哥远行探险。沙漠戈壁、热带雨林、蔚蓝海岸、古老玛雅遗迹散布在这片土地的游戏地图之上。动态天气系统随时变换，晴空、暴雨、沙尘轮番上演，同样一条公路，在不同时节会呈现完全不一样的面貌。在《地平线5》你可以投身刺激的各类竞速赛事，享受飙车的刺激快感；也可以放下比赛，单纯驾车漫游，追逐落日，打卡旷野与古迹。上百台传奇车辆可供收藏改装，既适合和好友联机结伴漫游，也适合一个人安静放空，沉浸式感受异域大陆的壮阔风光。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790661252_978792.webp
对于《极限竞速：地平线》系列而言，热血竞速是乐趣之一，但漫游与观景同样是核心体验。现实旅行会被距离、预算、人流等因素所束缚，但在地平线的开放世界当中，风景触手可及。凭借低门槛的游玩难度、电影级的风景画面、多元化的玩法机制，相信《极限竞速：地平线》系列能够在这个假期稳稳承接住那些现实假期里的浮躁心绪，为玩家献上一场自由驰骋的顶级视听盛宴。

content.v: 草蜢工作室宣布与网易游戏分道扬镳，重新恢复独立。在2021年，网易游戏曾从 GungHo Online Entertainment 手中收购了该工作室。草蜢工作室 CEO 须田刚一在谈到工作室重获独立时表示，工作室于今年2月推出了最新作品《罗密欧是个绝命侠》，并在3月迎来了成立28周年。
https://image.gcores.com/c56233a5226cd0c90b23fe02a9a2da83-1024-576.jpg
在广大玩家的支持下，这部作品获得了极高的评价与良好口碑。工作室对所有喜爱这款游戏以及为游戏发售付出努力的人表示感谢。在完成这部全员参与的项目后，团队在规划未来发展时，产生了为全球玩家带来更多元风格作品的愿望。因此，草蜢工作室选择再次以独立开发者的身份向前发展。
据悉，这一决定是在与网易游戏进行充分讨论并获得对方全力配合后做出的。双方将珍惜过去建立的合作关系，并在未来合适的时候期待进一步合作。随着自主发行经验的提升，工作室拥有了更广泛的选择空间。无论游戏采用何种发行方式，草蜢工作室都将坚持打造具有自身特色和更高品质的独特游戏。
工作室希望在迈向30周年及更远未来的新征程中，继续得到外界的关注，并对未来创作的作品保持期待与支持。

content.v: 蓝精灵或许并非《魔兽世界：无限》中唯一的全新原创内容。暴雪已就一批新职业向玩家发起调研，其中部分职业已是玩家多年来的诉求。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790814877_304067.jpg
有玩家将完整问卷发布到了网上，其中列出了多款候选职业：武僧、恶魔猎手、工匠、幻术师、萨莱茵、死灵法师、符文骑士、吟游诗人、守望者、女巫以及死亡骑士。每个职业都配有简短介绍、团队定位、护甲类型，以及部分示例技能的详细说明。
以女巫职业为例，这是一个身着布甲的远程输出兼辅助职业。其示例技能包括可为饮用者提供增益效果的“魔锅”，以及会消耗施法者自身生命值的远程攻击技能“虚空箭”。
每次谈及潜在的新职业，吟游诗人与工匠都是被反复提及的选项。暴雪设计的这两个职业，听起来与现有职业体系适配度很高。工匠的设定是可以钻进专属机甲作战;吟游诗人则通过演奏乐曲为队友提供治疗与增益。
恶魔猎手、武僧等回归职业的设定，与当前《魔兽世界》其他版本的同名职业十分相近。问卷明确指出，部分玩家熟悉的技能不会在《魔兽世界：无限》中实装;同时说明恶魔猎手将从1级起步，而非《魔兽世界》“午夜”资料片中的8级起始等级。
尽管这些职业的设定大纲都十分简短，但整体考量相当周全，我认为暴雪几乎必然会在未来实装这些职业，最快可能就在这款MMO于11月上线后不久。

从我每次登录都能见到大量新精灵角色来看，不少玩家都花钱在测试服体验了新种族。如果暴雪后续也开始售卖职业，我丝毫不会意外。理想状态下，玩家可以通过游戏内玩法免费解锁这些职业，但如今只要能盈利，暴雪是否会免费放出这类内容，我持怀疑态度。已有部分玩家担心，新增职业的强度可能会大幅领先现有职业，毁掉这份怀旧体验。他们的担忧不无道理，但《魔兽世界：无限》究竟会在多大程度上偏离初代《魔兽世界》，目前仍不明确。游戏将于11月4日正式上线，届时我们或许能从中窥见这款暴雪怀旧衍生作的未来方向。

content.v: 欧盟消费者保护合作网络已针对多家游戏企业销售虚拟货币及游戏内道具的方式启动联合执法行动，《 我的世界 》《无畏契约》《部落冲突》等游戏被列入进一步评估范围。行动重点关注儿童及其他较易受影响的消费者。

该网络提出七项原则，要求清楚标示虚拟货币和道具对应的现实价格，避免通过多重货币兑换掩盖成本，也不应迫使玩家购买超出需要的货币。其他原则涉及购买前的信息展示、包括未使用虚拟货币在内的14天撤回权说明，以及公平清晰的条款和适当保护措施。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790818926_488097_jpg_r.jpg
行动涉及Mojang、Riot Games、King、Supercell、Ubisoft、Crytek、InnoGames和Plarium等企业。监管机构称，此前与行业的对话未取得满意结果，因此将相关游戏列入进一步评估范围。
另有一项针对动视暴雪英国公司的平行行动，涉及《暗黑破坏神：不朽》和《使命召唤手游》。审查内容还包括玩家数据收集、可能造成沉迷的设计、家长控制默认设置、面向儿童的直接营销、购买前信息展示及账号封禁。
监管机构还关注战利品箱、误导性倒计时，以及缺乏依据的稀缺性宣传。此次行动已经启动，但游戏被列入评估范围，并不意味着其已被认定违法。

content.v: 《我的世界：地下城2》近期登陆Steam后，部分Windows和Linux玩家反映游戏存在启动故障。在SteamOS及其他Linux系统上，游戏目前无法通过Proton兼容层启动。微软已确认正在开发Steam Deck支持，但尚未公布完成时间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790817885_787573_jpg_r.jpg
目前列出的Steam最高同时在线人数为32556人，但这一数字不能说明有多少玩家遇到启动故障。等待官方方案期间，有社区成员在Steam评测中分享自行尝试的解决办法。一名用户认为，问题可能与微软商店接口所需的依赖项缺失有关；这仍是社区排查得出的判断。
一项记录在GitHub上的临时方案要求用户设置Steam启动选项、运行脚本安装依赖项，再将DLL文件复制到指定位置。项目作者称，这是一套供Proton环境使用的本地微软游戏服务替代组件，不会修改游戏，也不附带微软的程序库。它需要用户自行操作，不能视为正式补丁。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790817886_665364_jpg_r.jpg
按照项目说明，用户还需自行运行脚本登录账户并缓存Xbox令牌；游戏启动时，DLL会读取该缓存，游戏内不会出现登录窗口。

items.title: 买房“国补”来了！首套房贷贴息1% 最高省近5万
items.summary: 10月1日起，首套刚需房贷可享年化1%贴息，最高省息近5万元，政策期限暂定一年。

content.v: 10月1日，由财政部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局联合推出的居民购房贷款贴息政策正式落地。这是中央财政首次针对个人商业房贷提供贴息，主要面向刚需购房群体。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010900546060.jpg
根据规定，借款人需同时满足三项条件方可享受贴息：所购房屋为2026年10月1日（含）之后新发放的首套房商业贷款（新房、二手房均可），建筑面积不超过120平方米，且房屋总价不超过150万元。存量房贷置换及已有房贷不在覆盖范围内。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010903121113.png
贴息最高覆盖100万元贷款本金，按年化1个百分点补贴，最长可享5年。以贷款100万元、期限30年等额本息、年利率3.05%为例，五年累计贴息约4.6万元，月供减负明显。公积金贷款与保障性住房贷款已有专属政策，不重复享受本次贴息。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010903075361.jpg
目前工商银行、农业银行、中国银行、建设银行、交通银行、邮储银行六大国有银行已发布公告，正优化办理流程，为符合条件的客户提供贴息服务。该政策实施期限暂定一年。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/thewitcher3-wildhunt-remastered-review-blogroll-1790805134412.jpg

As the fantasy RPG GOAT, it really doesn’t take a whole lot for me to replay The Witcher 3. I’ve happily done so the numerous other times developer CD Projekt Red has revamped this masterpiece, but The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered seems to be the biggest overhaul to the beloved tale yet. A free update for anyone who owns the original, so many different parts of this already excellent game have been improved – from combat to movement to skill progression (not to mention the modernized graphics). After about 10 hours working my way through White Orchard and beyond, it’s already extremely clear that this is the best The Witcher 3 has ever been.
Combat is less floaty and enemies are (slightly) less stupid

It’s probably not controversial to say that one of the worst parts of this otherwise amazing adventure was the combat. Even after at least a few updates to it over the years, it still mostly felt floaty, a bit on the sloppy side, and enemies were a huge fan of just standing there and waiting for their turn to get decapitated. The modernizations made to combat in this remaster are its biggest step forward, as a whole bevy of tweaks have been made to address various sticking points. Geralt attacks faster and enemies are quicker to match your pace, which makes the process of chopping through your ninth pack of wolves much less irritating.

The camera and lock-on functionality have been the highlight so far, as you can now toggle between large groups of enemies with ease, and without the camera losing its mind. I didn’t even use the lock-on system in the original specifically because it was so unreliable, so being able to do so now has taken some serious getting used to. In general, the camera feels much better – less tightly locked to your back so you can handle groups of enemies more reliably (though those darn Neckers still like to sneak up on ya), and so far I’ve encountered far fewer situations where I felt like I was fighting my view as much as I was the monsters.

I’ve also noticed some new enemy behaviors that make swordplay more interesting, specifically how they’ll now retreat instead of letting you trounce them with steel, launch less telegraphed counterattacks, and disappear and reappear behind you (in the case of ghost monsters). All that did a much better job of making me feel like I was fighting intelligent creatures. Of course, compared to some of the stuff we see in action games today, I still do feel like the enemy behavior shows its age, and it was never all that great to begin with. Still, this is enough of an improvement to make combat feel much more engaging than it once did, significantly upgrading one of this adventure’s weakest points.
Geralt moves so much faster and Roach is less of a cretin

Movement is one of those small details that can grate the heck out of you in a massive RPG like The Witcher 3, slowly filling you with rage over the course of hundreds of hours. In the original, Geralt was often slow and had a lot of trouble getting over things. His rigid animations sometimes made me avoid ladders altogether because I just didn’t have the patience for it. In the remaster, Geralt absolutely flies over fences and navigates vertical obstacles with relative ease, to the point where it actually felt weird to see him be so nimble. I recall losing over an hour of progress in the 1.0 version when Geralt fell off a ledge no taller than a barstool and managed to break every bone in his body. This was reduced already in the next-gen update from 2022, but combined with the other speed and mobility improvements here, it almost feels like a completely different game – to the point where I’ve begun to wonder if it’ll make the map feel smaller than before as I get deeper in.

Similarly, Roach is no longer the annoying idiot she once was, now sporting much more intuitive controls that make her less likely to get caught on trees (which she now passes through if she’s just brushing against them while galloping), or end up on top of a barn. Most importantly, you can now loot herbs and whatnot without getting off your horse, which is maybe the single best improvement this remaster offers (dismounting every 10 seconds to pick a flower drove me to the brink of madness in 2015).
Skill trees are less restrictive

A pet peeve of mine in RPGs is when skill trees prevent you from playing around with different builds until you get deep into the progression. This is something The Witcher 3 suffered from quite a bit in the early hours, as so many of the impactful abilities were locked behind walls you couldn’t remove until late in the journey. The revised trees in the remaster take a page out of Cyberpunk 2077’s book by making perks more readily available earlier on, so you can customize how you’d like Geralt to get his Witchering done. I’m still early in my journey on this run, but I’m already happy to see that I won’t have to wait until I’ve invested a whole 12 points in a branch before I can unlock any good skills – so long as I’ve purchased a skill along the route I’m focusing on, I can now progress down a certain skill path with fewer obstructions.
Oh, yeah, this remaster looks pretty great too

Maybe this goes without saying for a remaster, but this is a pretty massive graphical upgrade, even over the one The Witcher 3 got for the current generation of consoles just four years ago. The lighting is much more dramatic, environmental textures are way more detailed, shadows and reflections are much more consistent across the board (especially on PC), and Geralt’s hair looks way less like a blurry mess than it once did. Again, this is all stuff that you’d hope would be the bare minimum when remastering a 12-year-old game, but it still warrants a shoutout. There’s even a new photo mode for those of you who want to take glamor shots of Geralt in all his new, high definition glory.

The one thing caveat here is that performance is still not perfect, and I still ran into a dropped frame or two on both console and PC. It’s a small price to pay for how much better things look, though, especially with the incredibly short load times I saw. And considering that the original had some framerate issues of its own, it’s not like anything has gotten worse here.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered’s greatest asset isn’t that it adds anything the original sorely lacked, but rather that it removes some of the biggest roadblocks to fun the 1.0 version was saddled with. Combat is more challenging but also easier to enjoy, movement is quicker and less irritating, and revised skill trees allow for more freedom. Even if it doesn’t manage to fix some of the technical issues (plus I’m sure there are some bugs waiting for me to encounter them that haven’t reared their ugly heads yet), it manages to make this classic RPG more enjoyable in 2026, and that’s worth yet another ride down its well-trodded roads.

items.title: Xbox不会卖！掌门人三妹发声：将继续重组

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010848434054.jpg
近期Xbox大规模重组引发外界对其未来归属的猜测。面对“微软是否考虑出售Xbox”这一问题，Xbox CEO Asha Sharma近日接受《纽约时报》采访时给出了明确回应：“Xbox不出售。”
她表示，公司将采取一切必要措施让Xbox重新走上成功轨道，并会继续寻找合适的合作伙伴、运营模式以及长期发展方案。相关表态也被多家媒体报道。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010848569446.png
此前微软已经启动Xbox历史上规模最大的重组之一。今年以来，公司宣布大规模裁员，并持续调整旗下工作室和IP的归属。9月最新一轮重组中，微软确认削减268个岗位，同时将下一部《光环》项目交由动视负责，Obsidian则纳入Bethesda体系，Rare和World's Edge也被调整至新的管理架构。
更早之前，微软公布的重组计划涉及约3200个岗位，并将部分工作室剥离或重新安排。Sharma此前表示，Xbox过去几年扩张过快、资源分散，需要通过“重置”重新集中投资重点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010849145447.jpg
对于未来，Sharma强调Xbox会采取长期视角，并称距离与微软完成这一轮调整还有很长的路要走。此前曾有报道称，微软内部考虑过将Xbox剥离为独立实体或寻找合作方式，但这些报道描述的是讨论中的选项，并非已经确定的出售计划。

items.title: “撤离仍然是马拉松的主要部分”——马拉松游戏总监向粉丝保证主游戏模式不会消失
items.summary: Just last week, Marathon's developers laid out a new roadmap for the game that'd bring PvE and deathmatch mode

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/03/09/marathon-blog-1773061347424.jpg

Just last week, Marathon's developers laid out a new roadmap for the game that'd bring PvE and deathmatch modes to the game, but now Game Director Del Chafe has reassured fans that the extraction mode will not be sunsetted.

When Bungie revealed the roadmap last week , some people were worried that the more hardcore extraction mode would be neglected in favor of the new modes, especially after the developer admitted that Marathon flopped because it was too hard . But, using the Marathon Development Team Twitter account, Chafe reassured folks, saying "We want to be clear, Extraction is still a major part of Marathon, and we're also going to continue updating it as we look to the future of the game."

Hey everyone, Del here. Last week we had a great time talking about the upcoming PvE and experimental PvP modes for Symbiosis in December. We want to be clear, Extraction is still a major part of Marathon, and we're also going to continue updating it as we look to the future…

Chafe also asked fans for feedback, saying "We'd love to hear from you on what you're enjoying about Extraction today, what you think needs work, and what you wish was there." Of course, Marathon fans obliged.

Marathon streamer Drewsky replied , saying that the among the main problems facing the extraction mode are spawn rushes and harsh death spirals that price players out. User nsorrey36 echoed Drewsky, saying "Echoing a lot of sentiment where it feels like lobby wiping is the go-to strategy of the run."

It seems like the perfect solution to Marathon's problems would be to introduce the new game modes coming in the Symbiosis update, while also finding a way to incentivize extraction players to not immediately start running for spawn points in the hopes of catching someone off guard. Luckily, it sounds like Bungie is taking any and all community feedback to heart, so there's actually a chance that extraction will look a lot different in a year.

All of these changes for Marathon are happening at the same time that Bungie is working on bringing Destiny back. The developer reassured gamers earlier this month that it wasn't done with Destiny , and is working on bringing back vaulted Destiny 2 content.

items.title: 直到有记录的历史上可能是也可能不是最古老的棋盘游戏现在也可能不可避免地成为 Roguelike 游戏
items.summary: Oh!Ware on Steam slaps a little Slay the Spire onto a 5000-year-old game.

content.v: Are you aware of Oh!Ware ? I'm guessing not. The deckbuilder has been on Steam for about a week as of this writing, with a humble 23 reviews to its name so far. It caught my eye though, because the fundamental mechanic underneath the very 2026 trappings of a roguelike structure and marbles standing in for cards is mancala—a slightly older board game you probably played at some point in your childhood.
And by "slightly older," I mean somewhere between 1,500 and 7,000 years older.

I was probably predisposed to love mancala as a kid: My dad was a big backgammon guy, and mancala is a lot like backgammon, but played with marbles or similar shiny colored glass pieces. (Kids still like shiny colored glass baubles in the TikTok era, right? I'm very out of touch.) What I didn't know about mancala until today is that it may be the oldest board game in recorded history, but precisely when and where it was invented is still undetermined.

"Some historians believe that mancala is the oldest game in the world based on the archaeological evidence found in Jordan that dates around 6000 BC," summarizes Wikipedia. But other, more concrete evidence of the game, as dug up by archaeologists, is thousands of years newer—around 500-600 AD. Mancala isn't definitively the oldest board game, then, with ancient competition from the likes of senet and mehen, but it's an OG regardless.
And now also a roguelike, though "deckbuilder" seems a bit off since the game is played with marbles. Does that make it a bagbuilder?

On booting up Oh!Ware's demo and skipping past the tutorial like I was hot shit, I realized I have not played mancala in at least 25 years and had no idea what I was doing. But I clicked a bunch to move some marbles around, collected mana(?) and killed a spider, who I really don't think had any business playing a board game that requires opposable thumbs. Then I was offered the archetypical pick three, but with amusing choices including "blessing marble" and "aggro marble."
I need to go study up on mancala now, but if anyone plays Oh!Ware, please let me know if I should aim for an aggro meta or a blessing meta. I really don't want to lose my marbles.

content.v: 近日胖东来创始人于东来在个人账号发文称， 从2027年3月开始，经公司研究决定，胖东来员工及管理层将实行每周工作5天、休息2天，每天工作7小时，每周工作35小时的制度，用行动让更多人享受幸福的工作和生活。

据悉，目前工龄满1年的员工每年享有30天带薪假期;试用期3个月后不满一年的，享受每月2天年假;入职即可享受10天自由假。这些福利安排，也让外界再次关注到胖东来在员工关怀上的持续投入。
众所周知，胖东来因其独特的员工福利政策和成功的市场扩张策略，成为舆论关注的焦点。在一个竞争激烈的零售行业，胖东来以其创新的管理模式和企业文化脱颖而出。其员工每年享有的假期福利，不仅在国内引起广泛讨论，也成为企业管理领域的一个标杆案例。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790809967_445423_jpg_r.jpg
此前于东来在直播中表示，胖东来的初衷是将中国优秀的传统文化融入企业文化，贯穿每一个岗位，让员工感受到关怀与支持，而不仅仅是为生存而努力。
值得关注的是，胖东来还特别设立了10天“不开心假”，管理层不能不批，不批就违规了。于东来表示，公司希望员工能够自由地决定自己的休息时间，让每个人都能在工作之余得到充分的放松和调整。
谁都会有不开心的时候，这是人之常情。当我们真正拥有这种“不开心假”的时候，很多人反而会感到开心。因为这意味着他们得到了公司的理解和支持，感受到了工作和生活的平衡。

content.v: 曾拿下2023年宝可梦密尔沃基VGC地区赛冠军的选手Donghun Youm近日发推文，分享自己参加巴尔的摩地区赛的离奇遭遇。比赛过程中身旁一名参赛选手身上散发出浓烈异味，刺鼻气味令他产生强烈生理反应，直接被熏到呕吐，一同参赛的朋友也被气味影响，完全没办法集中精神进行对局，一行人就此向现场裁判进行投诉。

content.v: 墨西哥参议员路易斯·多纳尔多·科洛西奥·里奥哈斯与众议员伊赖斯·雷耶斯提出一项规范数字游戏及其他数字商品销售的立法倡议。提案拟要求发行商提前设置机制，让游戏在官方服务器关闭后仍能保持功能；平台也须说明消费者付款后取得的是商品所有权，还是软件使用许可。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790808416_183721.jpg
科洛西奥此前批评，消费者按拥有者的价格付款，实际取得的权利却更像租用者。针对已购内容，提案拟将许可协议视为附合合同；如果平台撤销消费者的访问权，又未提供保存内容、补偿或退款的保障，按提案所述将构成严重违规。
提案还拟要求在墨西哥销售数字商品的外国平台设立当地地址或法律代表，方便消费者在当地提出投诉。
两名议员此前曾就Sony计划在2028年前停止生产PlayStation实体光盘的说法，向墨西哥反垄断机构COFECE提出投诉。他们认为，转向数字销售会削弱价格竞争，并使二手游戏市场失去作用。此次提案将数字购买权利的问题扩展到所有数字发行商。
这些要求目前仍处于提案阶段，并非已生效的法律。提案的编号和最终文本尚未确定，也没有表决日程；具体条款及能否获得议会支持仍待确认。

content.v: 《暗黑破坏神5》公布的目标发售时间为2029年春季。《流放之路》联合创作者、首席设计师Chris Wilson认为，这一时间点较为紧迫，游戏可能无法届时完成。这是他对开发工期的预测，并非官方延期通知。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260922/1790028648_748373_jpg_r.jpg
Wilson在讨论新作公布消息的视频中提到，《暗黑破坏神IV》的“憎恨之王”内容于今年4月推出。他推测，团队可能在那之后才把开发重心转向续作；若是如此，续作成为主要任务至今约五个月。他认为，这也可能解释了暴雪在BlizzCon主要展示概念图、设计规划和简短公布影片，却没有展示实机玩法的原因。
Wilson以自己参与开发《流放之路》的经历作比较：即便团队已有成熟的内容制作流程，以及专为同类游戏打造的引擎，《流放之路》开发仍持续了八年多。他认为《暗黑破坏神5》上市时需要有足够的内容来保持竞争力。暴雪此前表示本作角色职业数量将超过此前任何一部《暗黑破坏神》，包括扩展内容在内。
在Wilson看来，增加人手未必能消除工期压力，调整掉落率、平衡职业和深入试玩测试都需要时间。因此他判断《暗黑破坏神5》可能赶不上2029年春季，同时指出游戏开发中延期并不罕见。
暴雪总裁Faries此前谈及新《暗黑破坏神》和计划于2030年推出《星际争霸》新作时，表达过按时推出作品的意愿。目前《暗黑5》公布的发售时间仍是2029年春季这一目标窗口。

content.v: 最近荷兰警方逮捕了一名24岁的阿姆斯特丹男子，怀疑他属于网络犯罪组织ShinyHunters。该组织此前宣称对R星今年4月的网络入侵负责。FBI称，被捕者是ShinyHunters“涉嫌领导者之一”，但该组织否认他与自己有关。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790807617_685800_jpg_r.jpg
FBI网络部门助理主任Brett Leatherman还指称，被捕者及其同伙自去年以来入侵超过140家机构，获得至少7000万美元勒索款。这些数字均为执法部门的指控。
对于今年4月的入侵，R星当时表示，事件涉及第三方数据泄露，少量不具重大性的公司信息遭到访问，对公司运营和玩家没有影响。据称外泄的资料似乎包括一些财务记录，其中涉及《GTAOL》的表面每周收入；这些资料的真实性及具体数字尚未得到确认。
今年4月的入侵与2022年9月的《GTA 6》泄露事件，以及上个月出现的另一批泄露内容并非同一事件。被捕者与ShinyHunters的关系仍存在争议。该组织在一份声明中否认被捕者与其有关，并在逮捕发生后声称窃取了FBI的信息；后一说法同样尚待核实。

content.v: 近日《生化危机》系列执行制作人竹内润表示，团队正考虑重制作品与编号新作未来如何交汇。编号作品延续正在发展的剧情，重制作品则让玩家重新体验过去；随着重制系列逐渐追上编号作品所处的时代，两条线如何相接成了团队正在考虑的问题。

content.v: 育碧正在调整开发架构，将《全境封锁》《幽灵行动》和《细胞分裂》三大系列的统筹工作交给旗下瑞典工作室Massive Entertainment。重组后，Massive Entertainment成为育碧的第二创意业务单元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790806638_117898_jpg_r.jpg
来自蒙特利尔、巴黎、瑞典和多伦多的团队将以同一品牌开展工作。除上述三个系列，该业务单元负责的项目还包括《巨人行军》等原创游戏。
此前获任第二创意业务单元负责人的克里斯托夫·哈特曼，如今也负责Massive Entertainment。他表示，整合团队有助于汇集创意与技术经验，用于发展现有系列和制作新游戏。
这项安排是育碧持续重组的一部分。公司计划在第三个、也是最后一个转型阶段进一步削减1.8亿欧元成本；最初提出的节支目标为2亿欧元，随后调整了金额。Massive Entertainment仍属于育碧，旗下游戏的发行与销售也将继续由育碧负责。按照公司目前的说法，此次组织调整不应影响其对玩家已有的承诺。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/legend-of-zelda-shirts-1790805561902.png

Amazon is discounting a bunch of officially licensed Legend of Zelda shirts this week. The new sale arrives just a week before Prime Big Deal Days , with more than 40 T-Shirts down to $16.99 for Prime Members.

Seeing as I couldn't fit every shirt onto this page, I've gone ahead and curated some of the coolest designs. If you're looking for some of the more obscure options available, though, I recommend you browse the full sale yourself .

A 15% discount may not seem like much, but it's likely the best price you'll see on these shirts this year. Amazon regularly discounts it's licensed Nintendo T-Shirts, but we rarely see prices this low. If you've been wanting to spruce up your wardrobe, now's a great time to do so with a Zelda gift for yourself .

The biggest draw of this sale is that it encompasses such a wide range of shirts. 2026 marks the 40th anniversary of the franchise, and there have been many Legend of Zelda games since the NES version first came out. Because of that, there are a lot of different directions a shirt can take. There are subtle nods to the original game as well as more modern depictions from Tears of the Kingdom . Whatever type of Zelda fan you are, there's a shirt for you getting discounted here.

items.title: Rockstar Suggests Disney World and SeaWorld Probably Won't Be in GTA 6
items.summary: Rockstar has suggested that GTA 6 probably won't feature some key Florida attracts, such as Disney World and S

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/gta-6-jason-police-1787861023226.jpg
Rockstar has suggested that GTA 6 probably won't feature some key Florida attractions, such as Disney World and SeaWorld.

As part of a recent Game Informer cover story on GTA 6 , Rockstar Games seemed to suggest that its fictionalized version of Florida, known as Leonida, won't include every iconic staple of the sunshine state. Game Informer asked Rockstar’s senior vice president of environment art, Paul MacPherson, about some key attractions like Disney World, Seaworld, and Universal Studios, and how they would be integrated into the game. MacPherson suggested that not all of those locations will be featured in GTA 6, as they've had to be selective about what they include for the sake of narrative and game design, but maintained that the endgoal is to replicate the true Florida experience.

"We have to constantly evaluate the diversity of landscapes, towns, structures, landmarks, vistas, plant species, rock formations and everything else before we work with design and narrative to distill a list down that best works with and serves the game’s needs," he said. "So, while we may not have those exact locations, everything we have is geared to getting that full Florida experience!”

Rockstar didn't rule out any specific locations, but the comment does suggest that you won't find every major attraction in GTA 6. GTA 5 allowed players to explore the Venice Beach Boardwalk, which featured the pier and its various activities. Players could ride a rollercoaster and a ferris wheel, but generally speaking, it wasn't anything to write home about. There's no reason to do it more than once, and as a result, building an entire park around something like that may not be the best use of development resources.

The game will, however, feature a zoo for players to explore. Animals are a big part of GTA 6 , as the game will include over 170 different kinds of critters, including rare and legendary breeds which can be studied. There will be unique places to explore in-depth, even if there aren't any theme parks. Rockstar also spent an extensive amount of time in Florida, researching the area by living it directly. The studio confirmed that it even visted strip clubs and night clubs as part of its research.

content.v: 曾长期担任《光环》创意总监的弗兰克・奥康纳(Frank O’Connor)，在回应领英上的讨论时，提出了系列未来可能探索的三条路：延续经典玩法、大幅重塑游戏，以及尝试持续内容运营。这些是他对未来制作方向的个人建议，并非动视或Xbox公布的开发计划。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790802381_351116_jpg_r.jpg
第一条路是围绕移动方式、沙盒玩法和射击手感，制作经典的《光环》体验。O’Connor认为，项目规模可以由核心玩家支撑，同时争取更广泛的受众。
第二条路是更大幅度地重塑游戏及其世界。在保留沙盒动作基础的同时，新作可能采用不同的第一人称射击形式，或走向动作角色扮演，并以故事发挥系列潜力。
第三条路则是借鉴动视运营大型系列的经验，将玩家进度、商业模式与持续供应的内容结合起来，尝试每年或更频繁地推出大型体验。O’Connor强调，三条路都不容易，不保证成功，甚至未必切实可行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261001/1790802625_163182.jpg
奥康纳建议，《光环》的发行时间不要受硬件和服务档期牵制，也不要放弃系列的沙盒玩法。他还建议动视聘用此前遭到裁员的Bungie、Halo Studios以及其他相关被裁从业者。他表示这批开发者身怀大量才华，手中还握有不少过去遭到削减、搁置的创意构想，可以为新作开发提供助力。

行业近年预算高企、运营成本上涨，游戏行业裁员频发，Bungie处境持续承压，Halo Studios 更是刚刚经历大规模团队缩减，如今《光环》IP新作开发工作转交至动视，并且将组建独立团队，不会交由《使命召唤》的开发组负责。奥康纳认为想要让《光环》重新焕发光彩，动视可以吸纳这批熟悉IP历史的资深人员，Bungie拥有《光环》开发渊源，Halo Studios更是专门为该系列搭建的工作室，这批熟悉IP的人才，对于动视打造下一代《光环》游戏具备很高价值。

items.title: 《生化危机安魂曲》制作人“解释”游戏标题，让我们更加困惑
items.summary: The meaning of Resident Evil Requiem's title appeared to be self-evident when it was released earlier this yea

content.v: The meaning of Resident Evil Requiem's title appeared to be self-evident when it was released earlier this year. However, Resident Evil producer Jun Takeuchi's explanation for the title from the recently published Biohazard 30th Anniversary Special may be a head-scratcher for even the series' diehard fans.

"'Requiem' isn't just a title chosen for its meaning of 'requiem,'" said Takeuchi via GamesRadar . "The spelling of Requiem (REQUIEM) contains not only the 'RE (response)' ... but also a 'Q (question).' In other words, this 'Requiem' presents both an 'answer' and a 'question.' I will explain the meaning of that at some point in the future."
More intriguingly, Takeuchi indicated that the Resident Evil remake games and the current titles have been building towards a crossover since Resident Evil Village .

"Currently, Resident Evil operates on a two-pronged approach: The numbered titles allow players to experience the ongoing drama of the series, while the remake series lets them experience the past," added Takeuchi. "Eventually, the remake series will catch up to the era of the numbered titles, and the mechanisms for that are already being considered. In fact, preparations for this have been gradually underway since Resident Evil Village, including the appearance of names like Umbrella and Spencer, and the reappearance of Raccoon City in Requiem. This is all in preparation for a crossover."

Takeuchi didn't elaborate on what form the crossover may take or how soon it will arrive. However, Requiem has already served as link between the two eras by placing classic hero Leon S. Kennedy in a co-leading role alongside the new heroine, Grace Ashcroft.

The only officially confirmed Resident Evil game in development is Resident Evil Veronica , a remake of Resident Evil – Code: Veronica. That title doesn't currently have a release date. Meanwhile, the Resident Evil movie helmed by director Zach Cregger has crossed over $100 million domestically and $208.3 million worldwide.

Crimson Desert's first expansion was only just announced at the State of Play in September with a very ambitious October 15 release date. Unfortunately, it seems that target was a little too ambitious.

Pearl Abyss announced that the Charting the Unknown expansion would be delayed by two weeks, in order to "deliver a more polished and stable gameplay experience." But even with this delay, the new expansion is coming remarkably close to the game's initial release, and hopefully the developer will have even more content planned for the future.

The expansion comes just seven months after Crimson Desert intially released back on March 19. And while the reception to the game was mixed, a lot of its initial issues have since been ironed out, turning the game into one of the breakout hits of the year.

This first expansion will expand the game to a new zone, and will bring sea exploration to the already expansive world. Crimson Desert's Charting the Unknown expansion will now launch on October 29, and will set you back $24.99. And just like the base game, it'll be available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and PC.

items.title: Valve 表示《死锁》尚未完成，无法公开发布，但英雄外观和新游戏模式正在开发中
items.summary: A new development update leaves us with more questions than answers.

content.v: Deadlock's massive new update isn't a sign of an imminent public release, according to the MOBA's first proper development update . The invite-only game continues to grow in scope and polish, but Valve says there's still a lot of work to do.

"We think building a multiplayer game is very hard and risky, and the best way to minimize that risk [is] to make sure that we are able to have it in players' hands from an early state to help us shape it and tell us what is fun and what isn't," Valve says at the top of the update.

Six new heroes and a ton of visual overhauls came to Deadlock earlier this year in the Old Gods, New Blood update . While not everything in the game was touched, the breadth of the update made it seem like Deadlock was entering the next stage in its development. The level of polish in the map and many of the game's systems reached a point where it was hard to call it "unfinished" as far as early access games typically go.

But Valve can and will do whatever it wants, and in this case that doesn't involve releasing the game to a wider audience. Looking back at that update in this new post, Valve says "there was still a good amount of work we wanted to do on the core game itself before we moved onto more polish phases of the game development (like updating older hero artwork)."

Valve says the Deadlock team shifted away from focusing on specific areas of the game and started working on many things in parallel this year. Most of those things are in the new City Never Sleeps update, like the redesigned map and items, but some are still on their way: "This even includes things like progression and hero/hideout customizations, as we feel those are features we want to be able to adjust and significantly change based on feedback before the game is fully released."

There's an early Wardrobe concept art in Deadlock files that shows heroes in alternative outfits and it looks like Rem is going to have a rain coat: models/heroes_wip/familiar/familiar_rainday.vmdlmodels/hideout/materials/ hideout_wardrobe_display_bg_color_png_11fd48a6.vtex… pic.twitter.com/XPlz8JB717 September 30, 2026

"There are also other things we've been working on recently that are more speculative (as in we aren't 100% sure if they will be released or not based on how playtesting goes, though results so far have been promising) like large item redesigns/additions and alternative game modes that expand the scope of the game," Valve says. The new game modes could include the rumored PvE mode created by former Risk of Rain developers .

Visual updates for older heroes were originally planned to happen "towards the end of early development," Valve says, but it will "likely be gradually working on them in the near future for inclusion in upcoming updates alongside other work."

I'd love to know what prompted the team to move those up in the list because it doesn't sound like Deadlock's "early development" is over yet—or is it? Valve's update doesn't provide any clear indicators for when it expects it to feel finished enough to enter the polish phase.

Right now, it seems like the only sign of that happening will be whenever a bunch of heroes start getting attention. And even then, we don't know if Valve plans to release Deadlock to the public before every inch of it is perfect. If you want a peek at its spooky map or cast of weirdo heroes, you'd better find someone to beg for an invite because I don't think Valve's letting it out of the cage anytime soon.

items.title: GTA 5 Modder 通过非官方 Nintendo Switch 端口嘲讽 Rockstar，Take-Two 下令停止
items.summary: A modder who was porting GTA 5 to Nintendo Switch taunted Rockstar Games and was immediately hit with a cease

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/gta-world-blog-1790596404442.jpg
A modder who was porting GTA 5 to Nintendo Switch taunted Rockstar Games and was immediately hit with a cease and desist.

The modder, known as Mojso, was planning to bring GTA 5 and GTA Online to Nintendo Switch for modded versions of the console and got a bit cocky. After Rockstar Games recently posted its guidelines for modding (which forbids unofficial ports), the modder posted : "Try me Rockstar, [I don't give a f**k.]"

Three days later, the modder's Discord server was taken down for copyright infringement, but it didn't seem to deter them. After many warned them about how litigous Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two are, the modder suggested they aren't worried about it: "Copyright infringement is anything but enforced in Serbia."

Less than a week later, the modder confirmed they had received a cease and desist from Take-Two Interactive and thanked the company for its "mercy." As a result, the port will never see the light of day, as Mojso has stated that they don't want to risk any legal issues.

"Paralympics Productions is shutting down on October 3rd. Thank you everyone who supported us through tough times and lenghty development. I am sorry for not fulfilling your expectations and leaving you high and dry. I am thankful for Take-Two's mercy so this is the definitive end," they wrote.
When people pointed back to the modder's post about taunting Rockstar, Mojso noted that they didn't actually expect Rockstar to do anything.
"They tried me," Mojso said . "[What the] f**k [do] you want me to do? Fight with them in court? I wasn't expecting them to hit back hard."

The modder had been working on this port using leaked GTA 5 source code, which has resulted in a bevy of other leaks and issues. Ultimately, it's probably in your best interest to not taunt massive corporations that are known for hunting down people that mess with their IP.

items.title: DoorDash 订餐太难了，人工智能代理很快就能为你订披萨
items.summary: Ordering food through DoorDash is probably one of the biggest examples of how modern life has grown incredibly

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/04/01/cooking-1775053610172.jpg

Ordering food through DoorDash is probably one of the biggest examples of how modern life has grown incredibly convenient, but apparently, there are still some people who think scrolling through an app is too much work. Now, you'll be able to just text DoorDash and have it order food for you without needing to figure out what, exactly, you feel like eating.

DoorDash announced the feature earlier this week, and the idea is that you'll text an AI agent through iMessages – apparently Android support will come sometime in the future – an idea of what you want for dinner. Then, DoorDash's AI agent will browse through all the restaurants in your area and give you suggestions based on your past orders and what you included in your text.

One of the examples DoorDash includes is asking its bot for your usual Friday night order, and it'll remember what you usually get, along with any modifications you usually make. This is already pretty easy to do within the app, which usually has your last few orders at the top of the screen anyways. Ironically, texting a robot for your usual order might end up having more button presses than just opening the app and ordering normally.

In some ways, this actually feels like a blast from the past. SMS ordering used to be a thing, before the rise of smartphones. Dominoes introduced a way to order pizza by sending them an emoji all the way back in 2015, according to TechTimes . Though, to be fair, that was just one restaurant.

If you want to cut scrolling through an app out of your DoorDash routine, you can sign up to test this feature on DoorDash's website , but only if you're on iOS. Android users will just have to order food the new-old-fashioned way for a while longer. It's not clear when this feature will leave beta, but either way, it seems like ordering food will get even easier, regardless of whether or not it actually needed to.

items.title: MTG 玉米迷宫秘密巢穴 Superdrop 将 Jim Henson 的迷宫、KPop 恶魔猎手和 Marvel 僵尸带入魔法世界
items.summary: Wizards of the Coast trots out a new MTG Secret Lair on a monthly basis at this point, and while crossovers ar

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/header-1790793977489.png

Wizards of the Coast trots out a new MTG Secret Lair on a monthly basis at this point, and while crossovers aren't anything new for the franchise, this new 'super drop' brings Jim Henson's Labyrinth and KPop Demon Hunters to the card game for the first time.

Wizards of the Coast has just announced the Corn Maze Superdrop, clearly in time for Halloween, but instead of going with a darker horror twist like it did with the Junji Ito drop, all of these collections are relatively lighthearted. Of course, for most people, the biggest draw is going to be the KPop Demon Hunters and Labyrinth drops – the latter of which has three collections – along with a Marvel: Zombies collection.

The three Labyrinth drops are the highlight of the Corn Maze Superdrop, though. The Secret Lair x Jim Henson's Labyrinth Fear Me, Love Me drop is entirely focused on Goblin kindred cards, and is headlined by Muxus, Goblin Grandee, a Goblin Staple, posing as Jareth, Goblin King with a beautiful illustration of David Bowie. Of course, there's also a copy of Claim the Firstborn as The Kidnapping of Toby. For some reason, though, this drop also has a copy of Trinisphere, which doesn't really fit into any conceivable goblin deck, but at least it has some cool art of Bowie holding a bunch of orbs .

Of course it wouldn't be a Secret Lair Superdrop without some nigh-unreadable cards, and that's where the Secret Lair x Jim Henson's Labyrinth: Through the Labyrinth comes in. The art on these cards are all gorgeous, though I could totally see some of them being hard to parse from across the table. Still, Wizards decided to print Leveler in this drop, which you can combine with The Beamtown Bullies or Thassa's Oracle to make your pod wish they were dropped in the Labyrinth.

There's also a Kpop Demon Hunters drop, which has some incredible cards with combo potential. This one comes with a copy of Freed From The Real and Underworld Breach, both of which will be notorious in decks that are built around them. There's a reason Breach has been banned in multiple formats, after all.

And Wizards is still trying to work more Marvel content into Magic, this time with a Marvel Zombies drop that's focused on Zombie kindred cards. But, as cool as it would be to have a commander deck helmed by Zombie Thor or Zombie Scarlet witch, none of the cards in this drop are really worth the high price you'd be paying for them, unless you really love Marvel Zombies.

Some of the other drops are seriously cool, too. The Manufactured Grounds by See Machine drop brings some incredible art to the original artifact land cycle from Mirrodin. That drop probably doesn't make a lot of sense from a purely financial perspective, but damn, does it look cool. Then there's the Peace, Love and Treefolk drop, which gives Timber Protector its first meaningful reprint besides the Lord of the Rings commander decks.

I'm probably going to pick up all of the Labyrinth drops, and if you want to grab one (or all) of them too, the Corn Maze Superdrop will be available starting at 9am PT / 12pm ET on October 12. Wizards of the Coast will even toss in a Labyrinth-flavored copy of Maze of Ith on any order over $199.

items.title: 美国人正式将人工智能更名为“超级智能”，这应该可以解决一切问题
items.summary: We're one step closer to "Super Earth" becoming a real thing.

content.v: Yup, it's real. They did it.
Here's the full executive order , if you want to take it all in. Pity poor Sports Illustrated.

It's laughable, up there with similarly demented efforts to rename the Gulf of Mexico , Lake Ontario , and maybe New Mexico —I guess we'll see how that one ultimately shakes out. It's also pretty funny how "super intelligence" jibes with "Super Earth," the fascist homeworld of humanity in Helldivers 2 . Probably just a coincidence, though.

Yet somehow, I'm not inclined to laugh. That the leader—ruler, really, at this point—of the most powerful nation on the planet can just whip out bizarre ideas like this and have them treated seriously is kind of frightening, isn't it?

And it is being taken seriously, at least insofar as we can describe billionaire tech oligarchs lining up to say and do pretty much whatever it takes to keep juicing the share price as seriousness: A subsequent White House Accord on Super Intelligence was signed by a who's-who of people who have made PC gaming almost impossibly expensive:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sF8afmFnAKt88zqw7RtL8X-1920-80.jpg
And yes, they actually misspelled United States as "Unites States" under Trump's signature. Real pros at work here, top men all around.
Musk wasted no time publicly endorsing the rebranding on his X platform, although he was back to calling it AI less than eight hours later.
Super Intelligence https://t.co/ijlPkAmDBk September 29, 2026
Huang also signalled his obedience, referring to "super intelligence" no fewer than three times in his own X post.

Yesterday at the White House, leaders from across our industry came together to sign the White House Accord on Super Intelligence.The principle is simple: the companies building this technology have the primary responsibility to develop and deploy it safely, and to be… pic.twitter.com/RGMDYs9bhs September 30, 2026

Pichai, who was quick to acquiesce to Trump's demand to rename the Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario for US users of Google Maps, heaped praise on the heads of the administration while also trotting out the phrase.

Great to meet today with @POTUS, @JDVance, @SpeakerJohnson and Administration + tech leaders. Important conversation and we signed today the White House Accord on Super Intelligence.As I shared today, Google has invested hundreds of billions in the last two years alone, with… pic.twitter.com/04EirBfyUX September 30, 2026
And of course so did Zuckerberg, but on his own Facebook platform: "We believe superintelligence will create significant new opportunities for all people and businesses."

Humiliating prostrations notwithstanding, the practical impact of renaming artificial intelligence is basically nil: Apart from White House sycophants and quisling MAGA press outlets, nobody's calling it that.

But the bigger-picture consequences may be more, well, consequential : The accord, signed shortly after all the techbro billionaires lined up dutifully in a show of support for the latest addition to the president's world-changing "legacy," leaves the AI industry to regulate itself—"tremendous self-regulation," as Trump put it.

To quote from the accord: "In order to build a positive future for the American people and the world, we believe every company is responsible for developing its own technology safely and in a way that builds trust with customers and the public." It later states that "participating companies will meet regularly to establish standards and best practices to improve the safety of their systems." No mention of regulatory oversight, or any government involvement at all, is made.
Official. pic.twitter.com/BoTuIhxbTg September 29, 2026
At least one big-name tech billionaire spoke out against the idea of self-regulation for the AI industry, although it bears remembering that he's not beholden to shareholders anymore.

"It’s fair to say that outside of the industry, the awareness of the dangers of A.I. is extremely low," Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates told the New York Times . "And you can say that of academia, you can say that of think tanks, you can say that of policymakers, politicians.
"And part of the reason I’m speaking so loudly—as loud as I can—is that you can’t rely on the industry to self-regulate here. I mean, it’s just insane."
So I guess, taking all that in, it's not really all that funny after all. But it sure is super .

Emmy-nominated actor Vincent D’Onofrio has somehow found himself at war with a self-proclaimed ‘gooner’ over Deborah Ann Woll’s appearance in God of War Laufey.
The next game in the God of War series is fast approaching, this time following the adventures of Laufey, Kratos’ second wife and Loki’s mother in Norse mythology.

Given the current state of social media, it’s almost unsurprising that this fact alone has riled up the online rage machine — but it seems the controversy has grown so loud that other A-List actors are taking notice.

More recently, the conversation has shifted from Deborah Ann Woll’s in-game appearance as Laufey to her special armor sets within the upcoming game. As told by a Twitter/X user who goes by the name ‘Geralt of Goonia,' Sony’s Santa Monica Studio “would rather go bankrupt than give you an ounce of female attractiveness,” specifically when it comes to how much skin these armor sets cover.

Unexpectedly, Vincent D’Onofrio — who acted alongside Woll in Netflix and Marvel’s Daredevil series — chimed into the conversation to defend his co-star and proclaim his excitement to play the game alongside his son when it releases this coming February.

“Not that you asked, but… In no way do I agree with you,” he wrote. “Deborah is beautiful and extremely talented. She is as smart as a whip and a complete nerd. Also incredibly kind. How perfect she is! And a good friend. I am a fan of God of War. I, for one, cannot wait to play the new game with my son.”

Not that you asked, but... In no way do i agree with you. Deborah is beautiful and extremely talented. She is as smart as whip and a complete nerd. Also incredibly kind. How perfect she is! And a good friend. I am a fan of God of War. I for one cannot wait to play the new…

Despite getting owned by Kingpin himself, Geralt of Goonia continued his tirade, leading to no end of humorous responses and memes from players defending Laufey and agreeing with D’Onofrio’s excitement about playing the game.

Laufey has been at the center of a few discussions between notable folks in the gaming and entertainment space lately; the original creator of God of War, David Jaffe, called the game “stupid” during a recent live stream, and accused its creative director, Ariel Lawrence, of having a “lack of passion” for the title itself. (He later clarified these remarks in a tweet and defended Lawrence from the ensuing harassment campaign that started against her as a result of his comments.)

Prior to that, The Last of Us director Bruce Straley used Laufey as an example of AAA games that failed to “excite” him, though he similarly clarified this statement and apologized for bringing "uninvited and unnecessary negative attention” to the title.

Woll, for her part, hasn’t let the negativity get her down. Speaking with a fan at Florida Supercon in July, she said she’s confident that Laufey is a fantastic game, which has, at least in part, helped her avoid being affected by the backlash from trolls online.

"Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad,” she said.

content.v: A remake of the original Splinter Cell game was first announced nearly five years ago, and since then, we've seen exactly zero seconds of the game in action, or even a trailer. However, as we know with Sam Fisher, silence can be deceiving, and it looks like Ubisoft is actively recruiting for several roles on the project.

Spotted by Insider Gaming , job openings for a few different positions, including level designer and producer, have been posted within the last few months. This isn't necessarily indicative of how far along the project is--people are hired and leave all the time--but it does at least let us know that the project is still in active development. It's also not the first time we've seen job listings pop up, but with company in as volatile a state as Ubisoft, you never know.

It's unclear exactly what shape this remake will take, as geopolitical dynamics have changed quite a bit since 2002. It's also unclear how much influence it would take from the later games in the series, with Conviction and Blacklist both including more action-aligned mechanics like Mark & Execute.

Since the release of Splinter Cell Blacklist in 2013, we haven't gotten a new Splinter Cell game. Sam Fisher has made numerous appearances, however, including a few guest missions in Ghost Recon and an inclusion in Rainbow Six Siege. The Netflix animated series also released last year, with Liev Schreiber taking over voice duties from Michael Ironside.

items.summary: The " Xbox reset " has people wondering whether Microsoft is preparing to exit the video game business, but Xb

content.v: The " Xbox reset " has people wondering whether Microsoft is preparing to exit the video game business, but Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has flatly denied that the gaming division will be put up for sale.

"Xbox is not for sale," Sharma said to The New York Times . "We will do whatever it takes to set the company up for success, and we will look at the right partnerships, the right operating model, and everything needed to achieve that."

Sharma's comments come in the wake of analysts predicting that Microsoft could sell Xbox off entirely . Compared with Microsoft's profitable cloud computing and artificial intelligence businesses, Xbox has paled in comparison, and the gamble on Xbox Game Pass hasn't paid off, despite Microsoft investing tens of billions in acquiring several video game publishers and studios over the years. Xbox’s accountability margins amount to only a 3% profit , a small return on investment for its parent company.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has said that Xbox will have to start pulling its weight under Sharma's leadership, and the Xbox CEO previously told employees that the Xbox business was not in a healthy state. Nadella has also praised Sharma's cuts at Xbox, saying they have led to a "streamlining" of the division .

If Sharma is setting Xbox up to generate more profit for Microsoft, then it's all part of a years-long strategy in the making. Halo is now an Activision project, and is likely several years away as the publisher is currently building a new team to develop the next Master Chief adventure. Meanwhile, two of Blizzard's biggest upcoming games will arrive at the end of this decade: Diablo 5 is aiming for a 2029 launch , while StarCraft is set for 2030 . At the same time, Xbox has also tasked several of its studios with working on its Fallout franchise, with multiple new games in the series in various stages of development.
"We've got a long way to go with Microsoft," Sharma said to the NYT. "And we’re going to take the long-term view."

items.summary: Sonic has had a rough go at things lately, what with the myriad games that haven't been hitting like they used

content.v: Sonic has had a rough go at things lately, what with the myriad games that haven't been hitting like they used to. Sega appears to be aware of that and has acknowledged that, although the games have struggled recently, the franchise as a whole is back in the zeitgeist again--and it's all thanks to the live-action movies.

In an interview with Automaton at the Tokyo Game Show , series producer Takashi Iizuka spoke about the impact that director Jeff Fowler's three live-action movies have had on repopularizing Sonic again.

"Thanks to the movies, awareness of the Sonic series has grown, and more people around the world have become interested in Sonic as a character and in the games," Iizuka said when asked about the positive effect other media has had on the franchise. "That has contributed to game sales as well. Strong game sales mean we have more resources available when making the next title, which allows us to deliver something of even higher quality. That creates a positive cycle. In that sense, multimedia and transmedia expansion are majorly beneficial for the games."

Iizuka went on to say that movies weren't the only medium that has improved Sonic the Hedgehog's cachet in recent times. Anime has contributed as well, and so has Netflix, which has made film and television production more ubiquitous for Sega.

"In the past, even if we decided to make an anime as part of our transmedia strategy, we had to approach television broadcasters and other outlets that would air it, and we couldn't move forward without their approval," Iizuka continued. "With Netflix, on the other hand, once we decide to work together on something, we can distribute it worldwide. That's has [sic] been a major advantage when it comes to expanding the brand."
Iizuka's comments echoed similar sentiments from earlier this month. In an interview with One More Game on September 21 , Iizuka said the live-action movies essentially saved the franchise.
"The biggest milestone for me was the first movie," Iizuka said. "That had been a great hit and definitely changed the course of this franchise."

So, whether you like those live-action movies or not doesn't really matter because, in Sega's eyes, the Blue Blur would've stayed just that: a blur that goes poof and is gone ... forever. Iizuka did leave us a little nugget to chew on, though:
"Also, we don't use the game developers' resources for transmedia projects, so you don't have to worry about a new game being delayed because we're making movies or anime," Iizuka told Automaton.

items.title: WoW：Forever 为超过 12,500 件物品保密
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is looking to keep its secrets, as over 12,500 items in the game's files have been

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever is looking to keep its secrets, as over 12,500 items in the game's files have been kept hidden from dataminers.

The WoW: Forever beta is currently in full swing, and in addition to new dungeons, abilities, and even a whole new playable race, players are quickly discovering there are tons of new items that will completely change how this old-school version of WoW is played. Whether it's items with far more spellpower at early levels or gear tailored towards professions, Blizzard is definitely mixing things up so that the game's leveling journey, and its endgame, are going to feel all new.

As broken down in detail by Icy Veins , part of how Blizzard looks to be accomplishing this is by keeping almost 40% of the game's nearly 32,000 items a secret. Dataminers can technically see that these 12,000 plus items exist and even where many of them potentially come from, but can't see what their stats are. Many of these items are assumed to be all-new, though some are likely variants or modified version of items from WoW Classic.

Players have already taken a bite out of that 12,500 item total, having discovered over 4,400 "hidden" items in the Forever beta. Once an item has been discovered, it's then revealed in the game's backend. Icy Veins notes that not all the items datamined might actually exist in Forever, as it lists a number of items that were part of WoW Classic's Season of Discovery and might not make it into Blizzard's new version of the MMO.

Many of the hidden items come from raids and dungeons, including tier sets. So far, players have uncovered a few different sets, such as some low-level dungeon item sets, as well as full loot tables for early-game dungeons like Wailing Caverns, Ragefire Chasm, Shadowfang Keep, and the Deadmines. The beta's level cap is currently 20 (but will be raised to 30 before the beta's end), meaning players will likely uncover even more dungeon loot ahead of launch.

The aura of discovery and mystery players are experiencing as they explore Azeroth once more is just one of the reasons Forever's beta looks to be wildly popular . Multiple WoW devs, including Blizzard VP Holly Longdale, have commented that the beta is breaking player-number records, and Blizzard has had to raise the beta's population cap as a result. However, the beta hasn't been without controversy, as a recent streamer scandal involving gold trading has players demanding Blizzard do more to combat real-money transactions and gold buying.

WoW: Forever's beta ends October 21, with the game's full launch set for November 4. Blizzard's third version of its MMO will add over 1,000 new quests to classic Azeroth, as well as new zones and endgame content. Though there won't be a new class at launch, a recent Blizzard survey revealed 11 new potential WoW: Forever classes that could come to the MMO in the future.

items.title: 为了庆祝 9 月 30 日，也就是莱昂·肯尼迪内心的警察去世的那一天，以下是我在《生化危机》中最痛苦的经历
items.summary: This is in honour of the day Leon legally became a sad boy.

content.v: Today's basically a national holiday for Resident Evil fans. September 30 marks 28 years since the day the cop inside Leon S Kennedy died, the day he'll never forget; when Raccoon City was wiped out by Umbrella's classic mishandling of bioweapons in Resident Evil 2 .
So to celebrate the day that made Leon S Kennedy who he is, I've collated all the most traumatic experiences I've had in Resident Evil games:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Viqm8A2g3giwGaSzAWKwdN.png
The Baby

The Baby from Resident Evil Village is probably my most vivid traumatic memory of a Resident Evil game. This is for a few reasons. It was in a pretty recent playthrough of the game that I spent about 45 minutes trying to get through that section while having a panic attack with all my friends—turns out a giant fetus chasing you down is pretty hard to forget.

As you'll soon discover, one of my greatest fears is being chased, and this really pushes the fetus baby segment from uncomfortable into truly traumatic. No, giant weird fetus baby, I am not your dada.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KJguUUMdWCsrCjsCq3c6pe.jpg
Spider-Mum
I could've easily just put the entirety of Resident Evil 7 on this list, and I just might, but if I had to choose the worst part of that game was the mum, because why does she look like that.

I like spiders, we have an agreement, and I don't even think the boss fight was that hard but I absolutely did not care for Mrs. Bakers' look in Biohazard. The spider egg sack hanging from her stomach, her grotesquely long limbs, oh god it's just all bad. The only solace I have is that at the very least Capcom didn't go with its original concept art for Marguerite, because that's somehow even worse.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sup3NeFfkaLBS8tu9UTbFA.png
Tippy toes

Resident Evil 2 has plenty of blood-chilling moments and while I'm no fan of T-00, I don't actually mind him following me around, that is, as long as he doesn't break line of sight. The moment I lose sight of that blue fedora-wearing demon my blood pressure goes through the roof, not because I'm scared of where he might be, but because I hate the sound of his footsteps as he's trying to find me.
I don't think there's any noise worse than the sound of T-00's pace picking up once he's figured out where you are. Truly the stuff of nightmares.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3XPzKTMBMeTSEacWncTW4T.jpg
Little Angel

I don't think this list would be complete without mentioning Emma Kendo. Perhaps it's because I played Resident Evil: Requiem recently wherein Leon revisits this scene, but even still seeing Robert Kendo scramble to comfort his daughter as she turns is just horrible. I think the line "You're a cop. You're supposed to know something!" haunts me just as much as it does Leon at this point.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/X5HG66MASCKCyg7iA9XNfW.jpg
The bad ending

Leaving Moira behind at the end of Resident Evil: Revelations 2 really messed me up. It wasn't grotesque or scary like the other additions but it still sucked to get the bad ending and lose a character I'd been working so hard to keep alive. You'd think her telling me to leave would make it easier, it did not.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Ge3Tfs9EyFxR6JhCSNn8tV.jpg
Itchy. Tasty.

Another not so visually jarring but still traumatic entry has to be the Keeper's Diary in OG Resident Evil. This is a bit of a love-hate one as I do enjoy a good bit of world building. But reading someone's painstaking notes as they documented their infection of the T-virus and slowly lose themselves to the pain, while somehow not knowing what's happening to them, is pretty messed up.

But enough about me and all my trauma, what about you guys? I'd be morbidly interested to know what your most traumatic memories from Resident Evil are. But please, no more chase scenes, my heart can't take it.

items.summary: These were two separate tasks.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

Sometimes you have to roll up your sleeves and do what's necessary. No sentimentality, no squeamishness—just pure, solution-oriented bluesky thinking. This philosophy once guided Maximilien de Robespierre and now it guides me, in my equally epochal struggle to simply make Grand Theft Auto 5 boot in spite of the vast cargo of mods I have now encumbered it with.

Long story short: the game ceased to launch even in windowed mode, which had hitherto been a surefire way to coax it from its deathbed. After many restarts and a lot of graphics noodling, I was forced to ask myself if this was it. If this was the end of my GTA journey.
Then I started deleting essentially random files from the game's directory and now it works. So let that be a lesson to you.

Now that's out of the way: new mod. This one is called TornadoV and what it does, you see, is it adds absolutely ginormous tornadoes to the already somewhat hectic map of Los Santos (or what remains of it). Hit F5 to configure your tornadoes, hit F6 to spawn them.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DkLqppEN2yc462f28BBTEk-1920-80.gif
That last bit is a point of concern, as F6 is also my button to enable noclip and jet about the map at speed. So I can't do that without summoning a twister now, I guess. Okay.

It's good fun, anyway. Franklin really does go to pieces as the mod stuffs him in an express elevator to God's kingdom. As for the rest of the world, well, with everything in a constant state of explosion, fracas, and breakdown, a slowly migrating whirlwind really just sort of blends in.

items.summary: Microsoft’s high-profile deal for Hideo Kojima’s Physint is reportedly “substantially below what Xbox would ty

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/09/23/hideo-kojima-thumbnail-studio-tour-2022-1671650751472-1757434003477-1758599923814.jpg
Microsoft’s high-profile deal for Hideo Kojima’s Physint is reportedly “substantially below what Xbox would typically spend to develop a premium game.”

Xbox snapped up Physint after Kojima pitched the game to new CEO Asha Sharma — a pitch Kojima conducted after Sony canceled the previously PlayStation-exclusive project. For more on that, check out IGN’s recent interview with Hideo Kojima himself , where he talks through how he found out Sony had ditched Physint, and his concern about the fate of Kojima Productions.

Since then, there have been a number of online reports about the budget for Physint, with some claiming the deal was around $400 million. Subsequent reports claimed the figure was substantially less. Now, in a New York Times profile of Sharma , it was reported that Xbox may have negotiated a deal for less than you’d expect for what is expected to be a full price, triple-A spiritual successor to Metal Gear Solid from the creator of the franchise.
Here’s the relevant blurb from the NYT article:

After hours of diplomatic conversation about her competitors, Sharma had a rare moment of speechlessness when discussing the deal for Kojima’s upcoming stealth game Physint. She laughed at the idea of apologizing to Sony before shrugging and saying she was happy Kojima chose to work with Xbox.

The agreement was substantially below what Xbox would typically spend to develop a premium game, according to people close to the agreement, and included film and TV rights. Sharma also clarified that work with Sony would continue: “Competition and collaboration can coexist.”

Xbox’s deal for Physint includes adaptations (Death Stranding is getting exactly that). Kojima told IGN that Microsoft was “not thinking of just funding a game. They're thinking about movies and anime. It's more about the IP. Let's create a new IP. And that's bigger in scale, so to speak. And not many other game publishers or game developers have that kind of vision.”

So, whatever the exact figure, we know Xbox is funding Physint the project, not just the video game. So we might see a Physint live-action movie (will it go up against the Metal Gear Solid movie?!), potentially an anime, and maybe even more.

Video game production budgets have risen dramatically in recent years, especially in the west where development costs have skyrocketed. Triple-A video game sales haven’t risen to match these rising costs, putting pressure on the triple-A video game industry.

In the wake of Physint’s move to Xbox, Bloomberg reported that Sony had concerns around the success of Death Stranding, as well as Physint’s development timeline, budget, and platform strategy. Kojima Productions issued a statement in response, although it failed to directly address Bloomberg’s reporting.

“Make no mistake, this was a serious situation for the studio with a range of potentially significant implications,” Kojima Productions said. “While we recognise that the article may have caused alarm, we want to reassure you all, for the record: that the studio is in a healthy, profitable state, development for Physint continues to move forward with Xbox, and our relationship with PlayStation remains strong.​”
Physint remains without a release window. It is expected after the launch of OD, Kojima's next video game for Xbox.

content.v: The Street Fighter movie is shaping up to be a love letter to Capcom's classic fighting game series, with its goofy action and costumes, but if there's one crucial element it's nailing, it's the franchise's sound. Specifically, Guile's iconic theme, which is legendary for its ability to complement anything in life. How does the movie version match up? It's not straying from what is considered fighting game soundtrack perfection, but it is adding to it with a kickass guitar solo and a few more cinematic tweaks, allowing the main theme to do all the heavy lifting. Listen to it yourself, from one of the streaming links below:

Guile's Theme is one of those evergreen memes of the late 2000s and early 2010s, and while it's nowhere near as popular as it once was--YouTube probably got sick of all those 10-hour uploads--it's still instantly recognizable. The original theme debuted in the 1991 arcade release of Street Fighter II and was composed by Yoko Shimomura.

For the upcoming Street Fighter movie, the score was produced by Leo Birenberg and Zach Robinson (Cobra Kai), who say that the original game soundtracks were instrumental in shaping their musical identities. "As young and budding composers, we listened to Yoko Shimomura's iconic Guile’s Theme probably more than Raiders of the Lost Ark," the duo said in a press statement. "We hope fans will hear the love and reverence we hold for this music within our version of Guile’s Theme.

The full Street Fighter soundtrack will feature 39 tracks in total, and it'll be available starting October 16. The movie releases on the same day, and so far it looks like it's leaning fully into the absurdity of its source material. WWE performer Cody Rhodes plays Guile , and if you feel like cosplaying as him, you can grab an official Street Fighter popcorn bucket shaped like his iconic hair. Absolutely perfect, no notes.

Street Fighter will be landing a month after another film based on a Capcom video game series, Resident Evil , hit theaters. So far, the Zach Cregger-directed movie has been a critical hit and, commercially, continues to smash franchise records .
